passages.text: vincla secat: pereunt ictus manibusque remissis

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.870
passages.text: vana supinato ceciderunt spicula cornu.

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.871
passages.text: tunc miser et frenos turbatus et arma remisit,

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.872
passages.text: vulneris impatiens, umeri quod tegmine dextri

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.873
passages.text: intrarat facilemque cutem: subit altera cuspis

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.874
passages.text: cornipedisque fugam succiso poplite sistit,

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.875
passages.text: tunc cadit ipse Dryas — mirum — nec vulneris umquam

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.876
passages.text: conscius: olim auctor teli causaeque patebunt.

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.877
passages.text: At puer infusus sociis in devia campi

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.878
passages.text: tollitur — heu simplex aetas! — moriensque iacentem

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.879
passages.text: flebat equum; cecidit laxata casside vultus,

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.880
passages.text: aegraque per trepidos exspirat gratia visus,

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.881
passages.text: et prensis concussa comis ter colla quaterque

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.882
passages.text: stare negant, ipsisque nefas lacrimabile Thebis,

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.883
passages.text: ibat purpureus niveo de pectore sanguis,

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.884
passages.text: tandem haec singultu verba incidente profatur:

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.885
passages.text: ‘labimur, i, miseram, Dorceu, solare parentem.

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.886
passages.text: illa quidem, si vera ferunt praesagia curae,

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.887
passages.text: aut somno iam triste nefas aut omine vidit,

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.888
passages.text: tu tamen arte pia trepidam suspende diuque

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.889
passages.text: decipito; neu tu subitus neve arma tenenti

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.890
passages.text: veneris, et tandem, cum iam cogere fateri,

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.891
passages.text: dic: merui, genetrix, poenas invita capesse;

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.892
passages.text: arma puer rapui, nec te retinente quievi,

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.893
passages.text: nec tibi sollicitae tandem inter bella peperci,

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.894
passages.text: vive igitur potiusque animis irascere nostris,

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.895
passages.text: et iam pone metus, frustra de colle Lycaei

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.896
passages.text: anxia prospectas, si quis per nubila longe

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.897
passages.text: aut sonus aut nostro sublatus ab agmine pulvis:

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.898
passages.text: frigidus et nuda iaceo tellure, nec usquam

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.899
passages.text: tu prope, quae voltus efflantiaque ora teneres.

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.900
passages.text: hunc tamen, orba parens, crinem’ dextraque secandum

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.901
passages.text: praebuit ‘hunc toto capies pro corpore crinem,

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.902
passages.text: comere quem frustra me dedignante solebas,

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.903
passages.text: huic dabis exsequias, atque inter iusta memento,

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.904
passages.text: ne quis inexpertis hebetet mea tela lacertis

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.905
passages.text: dilectosque canes ullis agat amplius antris.

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.906
passages.text: haec autem primis arma infelicia castris

passages.label: Stat. Theb. 9.907
passages.text: ure, vel ingratae crimen suspende Dianae.’
